dedupe_keys.name: service line materials dashboard dc water

description: DC Water publishes this infrastructure inventory through its open data portal. The service-line inventory describes pipe materials in map and list form for active water accounts in the District of Columbia. DC Water updates the display daily, but contractor construction records can arrive weeks or months after installation. Homes without an activated account may be absent. A separate fire-service CSV subset is described; its addresses may be estimated through GIS analysis and may be incorrect. Pipe material information supports water-quality and replacement-planning representations. Access to the public display is free. The provider limits use to public information about the programme and excludes commercial, legal or other use; no standard open licence is stated. Caveats include historical and contractor-supplied records, no accuracy guarantee and possible changes to the display. The CSV files and embedded maps were not queried. Related record data-dc-water-sanitary-sewer-overflow-dashboard describes a separate wastewater event collection.
